name: Custom Wooden Keychain or Jewelry Stand
description:
FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted from high-quality, durable 1-layered or 2-layered plywood with a total thickness of 5mm or 10mm. The smooth wooden finish adds a natural, elegant touch to any decor.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Total size: 12 x 12 inches ~ 30.48 x 30.48 cm
    - Slot dimensions: 0.2 x 0.39 inches ~ 0.5 x 1 cm
    - Stand base width: 5.91 inches ~ 15 cm
    - Stand base height: 1.86 inches ~ 4.73 cm
    - Support notch and peg sizes designed for secure and easy assembly. The product dimensions may vary depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using UV printing for vibrant, long-lasting colors with high-resolution and sharp details.
    - Designs are printed on both the front and back surfaces for a complete, polished look.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - This versatile pegboard-style stand is ideal for organizing and displaying: keychains, jewelry (necklaces, earrings, bracelets, etc.), small accessories or keepsakes.
    - The peg holes are designed to accommodate various hooks or pegs, allowing customizable arrangement.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - With its personalized name feature and elegant presentation, this stand makes a thoughtful gift for: Birthdays, Anniversaries, Christmas, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Graduation, Housewarming, or any special celebration.
    - Suitable for all ages and genders, it adds both function and style to personal spaces like bedrooms, vanities, and workspaces.
     

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging:  1x Custom Wooden

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
